title: Digital Sovereignty and Collective Intelligence
description: A small cooperative game to improve reliable access to knowledge and collaborative work.

quests.title: Create a portable shared game state
quests.description: Define a JSON format that can be read and updated by independent clients.
quests.success_indicator: The example validates against the published JSON Schema.

quests.title: Preserve work across devices
quests.description: Test a workflow that can continue on a phone after a desktop interruption.
quests.success_indicator: A saved game state can be opened and continued on a second device.

events.summary: The project is being continued on a smartphone while desktop reliability is being investigated.
Use versioned JSON as the shared state format between people, AI models and deterministic software.

safety.notes: Never store passwords, access tokens, recovery codes or sensitive personal information in this shared state.
